headline: 1,249 deaths as measles outbreak kills seven more in 24 hours
summary: The DGHS reports a rising death toll from measles symptoms across several divisions, with Dhaka recording the highest number of fatalities.
details: Seven more people died with measles symptoms in a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The total death toll from the disease since March 15 has now reached 1,249, with 1,144 deaths associated with symptoms and 105 confirmed cases.
In the last 24 hours, four deaths occurred in the Dhaka Division, while Chattogram, Khulna, and Barishal each recorded one death.
Dhaka Division has the highest number of deaths this year, with 511 fatalities, followed by Sylhet with 201 and Chattogram with 110.
Over the past 24 hours, 1,251 people developed symptoms and 64 cases were confirmed, with 1,149 patients admitted to hospitals across the country.
Between March 15 and Tuesday, 201,468 patients were admitted with symptoms, and 193,301 have since recovered.
This year, 226,357 people have developed symptoms, of whom 23,695 tested positive for measles.
The DGHS noted that the real number of confirmed cases is difficult to determine because not every patient is tested.

headline_marked: Ex-Air Force officer's [[body recovered from Turag river]]
headline: Ex-Air Force officer's body recovered from Turag river
summary: Tahsif Souri, a former flight lieutenant, went missing after meeting a friend on Tuesday; his body was found floating in the river on Wednesday.
details: The body of former Air Force flight lieutenant Tahsif Souri was recovered from the Rajabari Ghat area of the Turag River on Wednesday afternoon by the Tongi River Police Outpost.
Tahsif had left his home in Uttara Sector 18 on Tuesday evening after being called away by a friend named Dwip, telling his mother he was going to speak with him.

His family members reported that Tahsif had gone out on his motorcycle, which is currently missing. Despite his family's request not to use the bike after a previous accident, he had taken it that evening.
At 1:35 am on Thursday, Tahsif sent a message to his mother stating he was on his way home, but his father described the message as seeming as if he was busy.
A person named Dwip, contacted by the family, claimed he had dinner with Tahsif and that Tahsif had dropped him off near his house before leaving.
Tahsif's father, Enayetul Karim, noted that his son had previously worked for the Bangladesh Cricket Board and Netra News after leaving the Air Force due to disciplinary reasons.
The Uttarkhan Police Station and River Police are currently investigating the matter, although no official complaint has been filed yet.
